subject.title: [Feature]: Show session and requester context in macOS exec approval popup

question: Which requester metadata may the macOS native exec approval popup disclose beyond the existing session key, and how should channel, account, thread, sender, or reason values be redacted or omitted?
rationale: The Session row is a narrow parity fix, but the requested channel/sender/requester fields can expose private context in a native OS popup and need maintainer-approved disclosure policy before implementation.

options.title: Stage session first
options.body: Add the Session row now and defer richer requester fields until maintainers approve a redaction and disclosure policy.

options.title: Define full metadata policy first
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers choose the exact Channel, Sender, Thread, and reason fields and redaction behavior, then land the complete native-popup update together.

options.title: Limit scope to session only
options.body: Treat channel, sender, and tool-reason display as out of scope and close the broader requester-context request after the Session row lands.

recommendation.title: Stage session first
recommendation.body: Add the Session row now and defer richer requester fields until maintainers approve a redaction and disclosure policy.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from current macOS exec approval history and prior review context on this issue.
